mainText: Good morning. Here is your market briefing for Friday, October 16th. Premarket is higher but mixed. The S and P 500 is up about two tenths of a percent. The Dow is up about three tenths of a percent. The Nasdaq 100 is up about one tenth of a percent. Money is rotating into bonds even with a hot producer price index print. The 10 year Treasury yield is at about 5.09 percent, down about 2 percent overnight as the bond bid returned. Biggest movers. First Citizens Bankshares up 7 and a half percent. RadNet up 7 and a half percent. Tesla up 4.6 percent on the redesigned Roadster unveiling. N V R down 8.6 percent. Cooper Cos down 6.6 percent.
